Name: CropInstantPickup
Author: xingxiX
Description:
[heading][b]简介[/b][/heading]
这个 mod 让掉落物不再满地乱飞，而是[b]直接进入你的背包[/b]。
名字虽然叫「农作物立刻拾取」，一开始只有农作物和果树，但是修修补补最后干脆全都加上了（，包括打怪、砍树、挖矿等
[heading]功能一览[/heading]
[table][tr][th]功能[/th]
[th]默认[/th]
[th]说明[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]农作物立刻拾取[/td]
[td]开[/td]
[td]收获的作物直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]果树果实立刻拾取[/td]
[td]开[/td]
[td]摇果树果实直接进入背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]矿石立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]石头、矿石的掉落直接进背包（不包括大石头这些）[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]杂草立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]割草的掉落直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]资源丛立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]树桩、原木、大石头、陨石等[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]可破坏容器立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]矿洞里的木箱与木桶[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]砍树立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]砍倒树的木头、树液、硬木、种子等直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]杀怪立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]怪物掉落直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]补给箱立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]海滩农场的补给箱[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]说明[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]大石头，树桩这些占地多格的属于资源丛，因此有一个单独的开关[/*]
[*]燃烧弹戒指炸掉的矿石和石头属于矿石开关管理（虽然是和怪物掉落一起算的，但是我给他摘出来了，感觉算矿石好一点？）[/*]
[*]背包满了仍然会变成原版掉落物，没注意背包容量还是有可能被超多的掉落物卡住（也许可以配合加堆叠上限的mod？）[/*]
[*]兼容拖拉机Tractor mod，果树大修Fruit Trees Reforged，Farming Level Affects Harvest等；自己测试下来，修改掉落物的品质或数量的mod都是兼容的，这个mod只是在最后把他们都收了起来[/*]
[*]多人游戏这一块，多人游戏中安装了这个mod的人砍树、挖矿等会立刻拾取，没有安装mod的人砍树和挖矿以及收获还是会变成掉落物；炸弹是例外，爆炸都在主机计算，所以放炸弹的人如果不是主机玩家，就算开启了功能也会变成原版掉落物；如果是主机玩家放的炸弹就正常收入背包；[/*]
[/list][heading]安装[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本。[/*]
[*]下载并解压到
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]。[/*]
[*]（可选）安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，在游戏内调整开关。[/*]
[/list][heading]源代码[/heading]
[list]
[*]源码 [url=https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup]https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup[/url][/*]
[/list][heading]碎碎念[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]因为下载了 Farming Level Affects Harvest（耕种等级影响作物掉落） 以及LevelExtender（允许技能等级突破到100级的mod）
之后，用拖拉机收个东西变得卡到不行 （尤其是那个蔓越莓我说） （还有我种满格兰普顿平原的上古水果）
搜了一下有没有能立刻捡起掉落物的mod没搜到 为了不减产又不那么卡于是让AI整了一个
以上是最初版本的介绍
可喜可贺的是在修修补补之后，现在大部分代码都是我写的了呢awa
[/*]
[*]测试的时候发现东斯卡普村里，鱼人莱西家左边的矿洞的可破坏木桶不会被拖拉机打碎，要手动打碎，很奇怪哦[/*]
[/list]
[heading]About[/heading]
This mod makes item drops skip the ground and go [b]straight into your inventory[/b].
Despite the name "Crop Instant Pickup" — it started out with only crops and fruit trees, but after enough patching it ended up covering just about everything, including monster drops, tree chopping, mining, and more.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[table][tr][th]Feature[/th]
[th]Default[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant crop pickup[/td]
[td]On[/td]
[td]Harvested crops go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant fruit tree pickup[/td]
[td]On[/td]
[td]Shaken fruit goes straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant mining pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Drops from stones and ores go straight into your inventory (boulders and other resource clumps are not included)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant weed pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Drops from cutting weeds go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant resource clump pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Stumps, logs, boulders, meteorites, etc.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant breakable container pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Crates and barrels in the mines[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant tree chopping pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Wood, sap, hardwood, and seeds from felled trees go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant monster drop pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Monster drops go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant supply crate pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Supply crates on the Beach Farm[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]Notes[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Boulders, stumps, and other multi-tile objects are resource clumps, so they get their own toggle.[/*]
[*]Ore and stone destroyed by the Napalm Ring are handled by the mining toggle (they're technically rolled together with monster drops, but I pulled them out — they feel more like mining, don't they?).[/*]
[*]If your inventory is full, items remain as vanilla ground drops — if you're not careful with inventory space, a huge pile of drops can still cause lag (maybe pair this with a mod that raises stack limits?).[/*]
[*]Compatible with Tractor Mod, Fruit Trees Reforged, Farming Level Affects Harvest, and more. From my testing, mods that change drop quality or quantity are all compatible — this mod just picks everything up at the end.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: players who have this mod installed get instant pickup when chopping, mining, harvesting, etc. Players without the mod still get vanilla ground drops for their actions. Bombs are the exception — explosions are calculated on the host, so if a non-host player places the bomb, it falls back to vanilla drops even with the feature enabled; if the host places it, items go into the inventory as normal.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0+.[/*]
[*]Unzip into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu to toggle features in-game.[/*]
[/list][heading]Source[/heading]
[list]
[*]Source code: [url=https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup]https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup[/url][/*]
[/list][heading]Ramblings[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]After I installed Farming Level Affects Harvest and LevelExtender (a mod that lets skill levels go up to level 100), harvesting with the tractor became unbearably laggy (especially cranberries, I'm telling you) (and the ancient fruit I planted all over Grampleton Fields).
I searched for a mod that instantly picks up drops and couldn't find one, so to avoid losing yield while cutting the lag, I had an AI put one together.
The above was the original description.
Happily, after all the patching, most of the code is written by me now awa.[/*]
[*]While testing, I found that in East Scarp village, the breakable barrels in the mine to the left of the fish-person Lexi's house don't be broken by the tractor. Weird.[/*]
[/list][line]
